recommendation.reason: 需要在 Windows 桌面中完成重复任务的 DSH 用户可以先用专用测试环境观察这套工具。它把桌面和网页读取与操作接到同一代理流程，但成功率、节省时间和恢复成本尚未对照。如果不能接受截图读取或真实动作风险，应停用相关工具并回到人工操作。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 的 package.json:78–84 和 README.md:217–224 表明需要 Windows、监督并且已发送操作不可撤销；隔离测试和停用提供部分退路，超过 0 分。恢复及模型费用未知，不能证明具有可行完整退路的 10 分。

--- ## 简体中文 这个插件让 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（DSH）里的 agent 看到并操作你电脑上真实的 Windows 程序和网页：找到按钮和输入框，读出屏幕上的文字，点击、打字，切换和管理窗口。网页默认在 DSH 自己的浏览器里后台完成，不动你的鼠标，也不抢前台。 **网页在后台完成 · 浮窗按步骤显示 DSH 在想什么、做什么 · 25 个操作工具 + 1 个管理入口 · 用到鼠标键盘时有明显提示 · 按 Esc 随时停止 · 中英文设置界面** **目录**：[1 快速开始](#1-快速开始) · [2 界面预览](#2-界面预览) · [3 能做什么](#3-能做什么) · [4 工作原理](#4-工作原理) · [5 设置](#5-按你的习惯设置) · [6 使用示例](#6-使用示例) · [7 工具与进阶](#7-工具与进阶) · [8 常见问题](#8-常见问题) · [9 数据与隐私](#9-数据与隐私) · [10 文档与开发](#10-文档与开发) · [English](#english) ### 1. 快速开始 #### 1.1 安装 你需要一台 Windows 电脑，并且已经装好 DSH Desktop。插件用的是 Windows 自带的 PowerShell 5.1，不用另外安装。 1. 右键点击任务栏托盘里的 DSH 图标，选“打开 DSH 终端”，然后运行： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-computer-use-win ``` 2. 再右键托盘图标，选“退出”，然后重新打开 DSH Desktop。只关掉窗口不够：窗口关了，DSH 还在托盘里运行，不会加载新装的插件。 3. 打开 **设置 → 电脑操控**（鼠标图标）看看各项选项。不改也能直接用，默认加载全部工具。然后给 agent 布置一个桌面任务，比如[第 6 节](#6-使用示例)里的例子。 #### 1.2 升级 运行同一条安装命令，然后像上面第 2 步那样完全退出、再重新打开 DSH Desktop。 命令里的 `desktop` 是 DSH Desktop 使用的配置（profile）。如果装到了别的 profile，正在用的 DSH 不会有任何变化。 #### 1.3 其他安装方式
DSH Web、GitHub 源、单独的 MCP 客户端 DSH Web： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-computer-use-win ``` 装好后重启 `dsh web`。用别的 profile 时，把 `web` 换成它的名字。也可以在插件市场搜索 **dsh-computer-use-win**，或者从 GitHub 安装： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win ``` 不在 DSH 里，也可以让任何 MCP 客户端启动它： ```json { "mcpServers": { "wincu": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "dsh-computer-use-win"] } } } ``` DSH Web 和单独的 MCP 客户端会用你电脑上的 Node.js 运行插件，需要 22 或更高版本。DSH Desktop 自带运行环境，不用另装 Node.js。 单独运行时默认加载全部工具。设置环境变量 `WCU_TOOL_MODE=lite` 只加载常用工具，`WCU_TOOL_MODE=lazy` 开始时只加载管理入口。也可以在 `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS` 里写一个 JSON 数组，指定允许哪些工具。设置页、对话里的操作记录和整轮提示只有在 DSH 里才有。详见[工具加载说明](docs/tool-context.md)。

**观察**：列出打开的窗口，读取界面控件，或者截图并识别文字。 2. **定位**：找到要操作的按钮、输入框或文字的位置。 3. **执行**：能直接操作控件就在后台直接操作，比如按下按钮、填入内容；不行再用鼠标和键盘，这时目标窗口只在这一步来到前面，做完把前台和鼠标还给你。 4. **确认**：等预期的变化出现，再读一次界面。没达到目标，就回到第 1 步。 插件会区分两种结果。输入类操作只返回“已发送”（`verification: "sent"`），因为程序收到了输入，不等于任务完成了。只有 `wait_for` 看到预期的窗口、控件或文字出现时，才返回“已确认”（`verification: "observed"`）。所以布置任务时，最好写明要确认什么。 #### 4.2 整体架构 图里蓝色的部分是本插件的代码，灰色的部分由 DSH、Windows 或浏览器提供。各部分的分工如下： - **插件适配器**（`mcp/dsh-plugin.mjs`）运行在 DSH 里。它把你的设置交给 MCP 服务，并跟踪对话的轮次，保证同一时间只有一段对话在操作桌面，还把这段对话的思考和步骤交给思考与操作浮窗。 - **设置页与操作记录**（`mcp/client.js`）就是“设置 → 电脑操控”这一页。它也负责把对话里的工具调用显示成好懂的步骤。 - **MCP 服务**（`mcp/server.mjs`）由 DSH 的官方 MCP 桥启动。它按你选的方案提供工具，检查参数后把请求交给后端。 - **浏览器通道**（`mcp/browser.mjs`）也运行在 MCP 服务里。调用带上 `browserTab` 或网页元素 ID 时，请求不经过 PowerShell 后端，而是通过 Chrome DevTools 协议直接交给浏览器。 - **PowerShell 后端**（`scripts/windows-uia.ps1`）负责读取界面、发送输入和截图。它一直运行，所以后续调用不用每次重新启动 PowerShell。请求排队，一次只执行一个，两个操作不会同时抢鼠标和键盘。 - **接管助手**（`scripts/windows-takeover.ps1`）是单独的进程，负责屏幕提示和思考与操作浮窗，并直接监听 Esc。因为它不经过 DSH 和后端，后端正忙时也能收到 Esc：还没开始的操作会被取消，正在进行的输入会尽快停下。 更多细节见[架构说明](docs/wiki/architecture.md)。 ### 5. 按你的习惯设置 在 **设置 → 电脑操控** 能在后台操作控件时，插件会优先这样做，不动鼠标、不抢前台。按坐标点击、粘贴文字和按键还是要用真实的鼠标键盘：插件先把目标窗口提到前面，点击前检查落点没有被别的窗口挡住，做完把鼠标放回原处、把前台还给你原来的窗口。动作打开了菜单、下拉列表或对话框时，窗口留在前面；你中途换了窗口或移了鼠标，插件不再改回去。这几步进行时最好别同时动鼠标键盘。 - 前台还给你之后，不指定窗口的后续操作和截图仍对准 已经发给程序的操作无法撤回。如果程序卡住了，要等它响应后才能停下来。 - 切换方案时，你的自定义清单会保留。保存的改动在当前这一步操作结束后生效，重启后也还在。agent 不能打开你关掉的工具。 完整说明见[设置与停止](docs/computer-use-settings.md)。 ### 6. 使用示例 #### 6.1 可以这样布置任务 > ID，例如 `t1a2b`。 2. 把这个 ID 作为 `browserTab` 传给 `snapshot`、`accessibility_tree`、`find`、`type_text`、`keypress`、`scroll`、`screenshot` 或 `wait_for`，就是在读或操作这个网页。网页里的每个元素都带 ID，例如 `t1a2b:57`，可以直接交给 `click`、`set_value`、`focus`、`invoke`、`scroll` 和 `element_info`。每次操作后，结果里会附上页面发生的变化。元素 ID 只对读到它的那个页面有效：页面跳转后要重新读；插件服务重启后，标签页 ID 也会换，要先调用 `list_windows`。 3. 用 `set_value` 往 `t1a2b:address` 写一个网址，这个标签页就会打开它；往 `new-tab` 写网址，会在后台新开一个标签页。 浏览器有三种来源： - **agent 浏览器（默认）**：第一次用 `new-tab` 时，插件在后台创建一个可见但不抢前台的浏览器窗口。用哪个浏览器可以在设置里选，默认跟随 Windows 的默认浏览器；默认浏览器不是 Edge 或 Chrome 时，用已安装的 Chrome 或 Edge；也可以选 Firefox 系，这是实验功能，在后台运行，见 [Firefox 系浏览器](docs/browser-bidi.md)。它每次都从新的临时配置开始，标签页放在单独的隔离环境里，看不到你的 Cookie、登录状态和浏览记录。插件进程退出时它跟着退出，空闲 10 分钟也会自己关掉。如果用的是 Edge，Edge 会自动把这个临时配置登录到 Windows 的微软账户；agent 的标签页留在隔离环境里，用不到这个登录状态，窗口上也不显示账户；临时配置在浏览器关闭后删除。在设置里关掉“显示 DSH 浏览器窗口”，它就在后台运行，没有窗口。浏览器操控不显示屏幕边缘和鼠标标签。 - **保留网站登录状态**：需要登录的任务，可以在设置里打开“保留网站登录状态”，默认关闭。打开后，DSH 专用浏览器不再每次用临时配置，而是给每个浏览器保留一个配置（`%LOCALAPPDATA%\dsh-computer-use-win\agent-browser` 下的 `kept-edge`、`kept-chrome`）：你在它的窗口（蓝框）里登录过的网站，之后的任务里还是登录状态，没勾“记住我”的网站也一样。第一次用到要登录的网站时，agent 会请你在这个窗口里登录一次，密码和验证码由你自己输入。你自己的浏览器始终不碰，不用开远程调试，也不会弹出允许提示。用 Edge 时，Edge 会自动用 Windows 上的微软账户登录这个配置，微软自家的网站直接是登录状态；不想这样就选 Chrome。关掉开关后登录仍然保留；要全部清除，退出 DSH 后删除上面的文件夹。风险：DSH 会以你的身份操作你在这里登录过的网站；网页上的文字可能诱导 agent；DSH 浏览器开着时，本机其他程序也能通过它的调试端口连上它。 - **操作已打开的浏览器（实验性）**：默认关闭。打开后，`list_windows` 只读取浏览器写下的 `DevToolsActivePort` 文件，把你的浏览器列为“可以连接”，并给出 `"<浏览器 ID>:connect"` 入口，这时既不连接，也不会弹出提示。agent 会先请你准备在浏览器里点“允许”，再用 `set_value` 往这个入口写 `connect`，浏览器这时才问你是否允许。被拒绝或超时就停下，不自动重试，列表里会标出“未获允许”或“已超时”，所以提示不会叠在一起。连上以后，你自己标签页的网址会去掉 `?` 后面的参数和 `#` 片段；agent 只操作你提到的标签页和它自己打开的标签页，发送、购买、删除或改账户设置之前会先问你。断开时只断开连接，不关你的浏览器。连接期间，浏览器顶部会显示受自动测试软件控制的提示。 浏览器通道还读不到 iframe 里的内容，遇到时 agent 会改用电脑操控，通过 UIA 读取和操作。显示浏览器窗口时，Chrome 自己的 JavaScript 弹窗（alert、confirm 这类）有时会短暂切到前台。Ctrl+L、Ctrl+T 这类快捷键属于浏览器窗口，网页内部收不到，请改用 `address`、`new-tab` 和 `close_window`。环境变量和返回格式见 [MCP 工具文档](docs/wiki/mcp-tools.md#browser-lane)。 ### 8. 常见问题 #### 8.1 装好了，却看不到工具或设置页，或者还是旧版本？ 最常见的原因是 DSH Desktop 没有完全重启：只关窗口时，DSH 还在托盘里运行旧版插件。请右键托盘图标选“退出”，再重新打开。 也要确认插件装到了 DSH 正在用的 profile。版本号可以在 MCP 返回的 `initialize.serverInfo.version` 里看；选“全部”方案时，也可以让 agent 调用 `health` 检查连接。同一个 profile 里只应有一个 `serverName: wincu` 服务。如果旧版本留下过重复的手动配置，先备份，再按[升级说明](docs/computer-use-settings.md)处理。 保存设置后，DSH 会在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写一条 `id: mcp-dsh-computer-use-win` 的记录，里面就是你的设置。这条记录是正常的，不要删。选了“精简”或“懒启动”时，不在方案里的工具（比如 `health`）本来就不会出现，直接调用会显示 unknown tool。让 agent 调用管理入口 `windows_computer_use_tools`（`{"operation":"list"}`），就能看到哪些工具已经加载、哪些还能加载。如果保存的设置里有这个版本不认识的值，比如换过版本以后，插件会对这一项改用默认值、照常加载，并在 `tools` 列表的 `notices` 和 `health` 里写明改了哪一项。 提交问题时，请附上 DSH Desktop、dsh 内核和插件的版本号，以及去掉隐私后的报错文字。 #### 8.2 为什么点击或输入没有反应？ 先看目标窗口有没有被挡住、程序是不是卡住了。按坐标点击时，落点露出的是别的窗口（比如通知）就不会点下去，结果会说出挡住它的窗口（`POINT_COVERED`）；结果里的 `foreground` 和 `pointer` 说明这一步有没有借用前台、有没有还回去。Chromium、Electron 和部分 WinUI 程序会忽略后台输入，所以优先用 UIA 操作，或者先把目标窗口切到前台再输入，然后看看实际效果。以管理员身份运行的窗口和 UAC 确认界面受 Windows 权限保护，插件无法操作。插件还需要一个正常可用的桌面会话。 #### 8.3 支持 PowerShell 7、其他系统，或者自带看图模型吗？ 只支持 Windows。默认用 PowerShell 5.1，它的文字识别（WinRT OCR）经过了真实测试。自动测试同时覆盖 PowerShell 5.1 和 7：在 7 上，界面读取和截图有真实测试，但文字识别只测了协议，所以还不能保证 7 上的文字识别可用。 插件只提供桌面工具，不带模型、API key，也不带 OmniParser、UI-TARS 这类看图解析工具。能看图的模型或单独的解析服务可以读截图，再把位置交给插件去操作。 ### 9. 数据与隐私 界面读取、文字识别、截图和输入都在你的电脑上完成，结果交给 DSH 或其他调用方。这些内容会不会再发给远程模型，取决于你的 DSH 和模型设置。截图和读出的文字可能包含窗口里的敏感信息，所以分享日志或提 Issue 之前，请先遮住账号、路径、密码和私人对话。 浏览器通道读到的网页内容同样在本机处理，再交给调用方。agent 浏览器默认不带任何登录；打开“保留网站登录状态”后，agent 能读取和操作你在 DSH 浏览器里登录过的网站。打开“操作已打开的浏览器”并允许连接后，agent 能读取和操作那个浏览器里所有已登录的网站，所以只在需要时打开，用完可以在浏览器里关掉远程调试。网页里的文字也可能夹带写给 agent 的指令，所以页面大纲的开头会提醒模型：网页内容不可信，只听你的指示。 ### 10. 文档与开发 #### 10.1 文档 Quick start #### 1.1 Install You need a Windows computer with DSH Desktop installed. The plugin uses Windows PowerShell 5.1, which comes with Windows, so there is nothing else to install. 1. Right-click the DSH icon in the taskbar tray, choose **Open DSH Terminal**, and run: ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-computer-use-win ``` 2. Right-click the tray icon again, choose **Quit**, then open DSH Desktop again. Closing the window is not enough: DSH keeps running in the tray and does not load the new plugin. 3. Open **Settings → Computer Use** (the mouse icon; 电脑操控 in the Chinese interface) to look around. You don't have to change anything: all tools are loaded by default. Then give the agent a desktop task, such as one from [section 6](#6-try-a-task). #### 1.2 Upgrade Run the same install command, then fully quit and reopen DSH Desktop as in step 2 above. The `desktop` in the command is the profile that DSH Desktop uses. If you install into another profile, the DSH you are using does not change. #### 1.3 Other ways to install
DSH Web, GitHub, standalone MCP clients For DSH Web: ```powershell dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-computer-use-win ``` Restart `dsh web` after installing. If you use another profile, replace `web` with its name. You can also search the plugin marketplace for **dsh-computer-use-win**, or install from GitHub: ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Yu-tao-Li/dsh-computer-use-win ``` Outside DSH, any MCP client can launch it: ```json { "mcpServers": { "wincu": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "dsh-computer-use-win"] } } } ``` DSH Web and standalone MCP clients run the plugin with the Node.js on your computer, which must be version 22 or later. DSH Desktop brings its own runtime, so it needs no separate Node.js. Run on its own, the server loads all tools by default. Set `WCU_TOOL_MODE=lite` to load only the common tools, or `WCU_TOOL_MODE=lazy` to start with just the management entry. You can also list the allowed tools as a JSON array in `WCU_ENABLED_TOOLS`. The records are still there when you reopen the conversation. ### 4. How it works #### 4.1 How a desktop task runs The agent takes every step as **look → locate → act → confirm**. The lower half of the first figure shows this loop: 1. **Look**: list the open windows, read the controls, or take a screenshot and recognize the text. 2. **Locate**: find the button, text field or piece of text to work on. 3. **Act**: operate the control directly in the background when possible, such as pressing a button or filling in a field; otherwise use the mouse and keyboard, with the target window in front for that step only and the foreground and mouse given back afterwards. 4. **Confirm**: wait for the expected change and read the screen again. If the goal is not met yet, go back to step 1. The plugin keeps two kinds of result apart. Input actions only report “sent” (`verification: "sent"`), because an app receiving input does not mean the task is done. Only `wait_for` reports “observed” (`verification: "observed"`), when the expected window, control or text actually appears. So when you give a task, say what should be checked. #### 4.2 Architecture The blue parts are this plugin's code, and the grey parts come from DSH, Windows or the browser. Here is what each part does: - The **plugin adapter** (`mcp/dsh-plugin.mjs`) runs inside DSH. It passes your settings to the MCP server and tracks conversation turns, so only one conversation uses the desktop at a time. It also hands the conversation's reasoning and steps to the overlay. - The **settings page and step records** (`mcp/client.js`) are the Settings → Computer Use page. The same file turns the tool calls in a conversation into readable steps. - The **MCP server** (`mcp/server.mjs`) is started by DSH's official MCP bridge. It offers the tools of your preset, checks the arguments and passes each request to the backend. - The **browser lane** (`mcp/browser.mjs`) also runs in the MCP server. When a call carries `browserTab` or a page element ID, it skips the PowerShell backend and goes straight to the browser over the Chrome DevTools Protocol. - The **PowerShell backend** (`scripts/windows-uia.ps1`) reads the screen, sends input and takes screenshots. It stays running, so later calls skip PowerShell startup. Requests wait in a queue and run one at a time, so two actions never fight over the mouse and keyboard. - The **takeover helper** (`scripts/windows-takeover.ps1`) is a separate process that draws the indicators and the reasoning and progress overlay, and listens for Esc itself. Because it goes through neither DSH nor the backend, it hears Esc even while the backend is busy: actions that have not started are cancelled, and input in progress stops as soon as it can. See the [architecture notes](docs/wiki/architecture.md) for more detail. ### 5. Make it yours Change these in **Settings → Computer Use**. Through the `tools` entry, the agent can read a tool's description, and unload or reload tools you have allowed. `reset` returns to your saved startup set. Unloading a tool does not remove its description or results from the conversation. #### 7.3 Tips When UIA can find a control, operate it directly with `invoke` or `set_value`; both run in the background. With `action`, `invoke` can also expand or collapse a control or scroll it into view, and `scroll` on an element ID scrolls in the background first. When UIA finds nothing, or very little, read the screen text with OCR, and let a model that can see images read the screenshot for icons and layout. OCR returns only text and screen positions; it never makes up control IDs. Look again after a window moves or a control changes. Electron apps, Chrome and Edge are all built on Chromium. Such an app builds the controls of a page only once another program reads the page. So the first time the plugin reads one of these windows, it turns the page's control tree on, and the page's buttons and input boxes usually become readable within half a second. `webContent` in the result tells you whether the page is ready. If it says `starting`, wait a moment and read again. It reads the page structure over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), then clicks, fills and selects elements directly. All of this happens inside the browser: your mouse does not move, the clipboard is not used and no window comes to the front, so tabs in the background work too. Browser Use adds no tools; what is new is a `browserTab` argument and page element IDs: 1. The result of `list_windows` includes `browserLane`, which lists the tabs of connected browsers. Each tab has an ID such as `t1a2b`. 2. Pass that ID as `browserTab` to `snapshot`, `accessibility_tree`, `find`, `type_text`, `keypress`, `scroll`, `screenshot` or `wait_for` to read or operate that page. Every element on the page comes with an ID such as `t1a2b:57`, which works directly in `click`, `set_value`, `focus`, `invoke`, `scroll` and `element_info`. After each action, the result shows what changed on the page. An element ID is valid only for the page it was read from: read the page again after it navigates. After the plugin's server restarts, tab IDs change too, so call `list_windows` first. 3. `set_value` with a web address on `t1a2b:address` opens it in that tab; on `new-tab`, it opens the address in a new background tab. The browser comes from one of three places: - **The agent browser (default).** The first `new-tab` opens a visible browser window without bringing it to the front. Which browser is a setting: by default the Windows default browser, and an installed Chrome or Edge when that is neither; the Firefox family is an experimental choice that runs in the background (see [Firefox-family browsers](docs/browser-bidi.md)). It starts from a fresh temporary profile every time, and its tabs run in a separate isolated context, so they never see your cookies, sign-ins or history. It exits with the plugin process and closes itself after 10 idle minutes. Edge signs a new profile in to your Windows Microsoft account on its own; the agent's tabs stay in the isolated context and cannot use that sign-in, the window shows no account, and the temporary profile is deleted after the browser closes. Turn off Show the DSH browser window in settings to run it in the background with no window. Browser Use shows no screen edges or pointer tag. - **Keep website sign-ins.** For tasks that need you signed in, turn on Keep website sign-ins in the settings; it is off by default. The first time a task needs a site that asks you to sign in, the agent asks you to sign in once in that window; you type passwords and codes yourself. Your own browser is never touched: no remote debugging to turn on and no prompts to allow. With Edge, Edge signs this profile in with the Microsoft account of your Windows, so Microsoft’s own sites are signed in already; choose Chrome to avoid that. Sign-ins stay when you turn the switch off; to remove them all, exit DSH and delete that folder. While connected, the browser shows a bar saying it is controlled by automated test software. FAQ #### 8.1 It's installed, but I see no tools or settings, or an old version is still running Most often, DSH Desktop was not fully restarted. Closing the window leaves DSH running in the tray with the old plugin, so right-click the tray icon, choose Quit, and open DSH Desktop again. Also check that the plugin went into the profile DSH is actually using. The version appears in the MCP `initialize.serverInfo.version`; with All selected, the agent can also call `health` to check the connection. Each profile should have only one `serverName: wincu` service. If an older version left a duplicate manual entry, back it up first, then follow the [upgrade notes](docs/computer-use-settings.md). When you save settings, DSH writes a row with `id: mcp-dsh-computer-use-win` into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. That row holds your settings, so keep it. With Lite or Lazy selected, tools outside the preset, such as `health`, are not listed, and calling one directly returns unknown tool. Ask the agent to call the management entry `windows_computer_use_tools` with `{"operation":"list"}` to see which tools are loaded and which can be loaded. If a saved setting holds a value this version does not offer, for example after switching versions, the plugin uses the default for that setting, loads as usual, and names the reset value under `notices` in the tools list and in `health`. When you report an issue, include the DSH Desktop, dsh core and plugin versions, plus the error text with private details removed. #### 8.2 Why did a click or typed text have no effect? Check that the target window is not covered and still responds. A click at a screen position whose point shows another window, such as a notification, is not sent, and the result names the covering window (`POINT_COVERED`). The `foreground` and `pointer` fields of a result say whether the step borrowed the foreground and whether it gave it back. Chromium, Electron and some WinUI apps ignore input sent to background windows, so prefer UIA, or bring the window to the front before typing, and then look at the result. Windows protects apps running as administrator and the UAC prompt, so the plugin cannot operate them. The plugin also needs a normal, unlocked desktop session. #### 8.3 What about PowerShell 7, other systems or a built-in vision model? It works on Windows only. PowerShell 5.1 is the default, and its text recognition (WinRT OCR) has been tested on real screens. The automated tests cover both PowerShell 5.1 and 7. Under 7, reading controls and taking screenshots are tested for real, but text recognition is only tested at the protocol level, so OCR under PowerShell 7 is not guaranteed. The plugin provides desktop tools only. It does not include a model, an API key, or image parsers such as OmniParser or UI-TARS. A model that can see images, or a separate parsing service, can read the screenshots and pass positions back to the tools. ### 9. Data and privacy Reading controls, text recognition, screenshots and input all run on your computer. The results go to DSH or another caller, and whether they are then sent to a remote model depends on your DSH and model settings. Screenshots and recognized text can include sensitive content from your windows, so hide accounts, paths, passwords and private chats before you share logs or open an issue. Pages read through the browser lane are also processed on your computer before they go to the caller. By default the agent browser carries no sign-ins; with Keep website sign-ins on, the agent can read and operate the sites you signed in to in the DSH browser. With Use an already open browser on and a connection allowed, the agent can read and operate every site signed in to in that browser, so turn it on only when needed, and you can turn remote debugging off in the browser afterwards. Page text can also carry instructions aimed at the agent, so every page outline starts by reminding the model that page content is untrusted and only your instructions count. ### 10.
